stem: A case file contains a leaf photo, an EC value from another irrigation zone, and a verbal claim of root rot. What is the best first step?
choices: Treat all three as confirmation of root rot.
Separate each item by source, identity, time and what it can actually support before building the differential.
Discard the photo because images are never useful.
Use the EC value as proof of nutrient toxicity.
rationale: Case intake should separate evidence types and their identity/context limits before interpretation.
